summary: Bitmap fonts 1 and 2 to Black Chancery and AvQest TTFs
author: pm
body:
Replace two of the client's bitmap sprite fonts with TTF fonts. The user, 2026-11-25, gave the mapping and notes:

| Sprite font (staged/client/sprites/interface/sprite_fonts/) | Today | Replacement | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 000.png (sprite 0, InterfaceFont1) | GameFont::Bitmap1, '!'..'z' (screen_loading.cpp:135, as of 2026-11-25); 67 uses in sources/client (measured) | Black Chancery, Helbreath-SDL working/fonts/black_chancery.ttf | user: "The numerics will need to be shifted so they are aligned properly instead of however black_chancery does their numerics. But essentially the same." |
| 001.png (sprite 1, InterfaceFont2) | GameFont::Bitmap2, ' '..'~' dynamic spacing (screen_loading.cpp:145); 9 uses (measured) | AvQest, Helbreath-SDL working/fonts/avqest.ttf | user: "This is a 1:1 font we will use" |

Licences, read from the font files on 2026-11-25:
- black_chancery.ttf: "From Doug Miles' Black Chancery bitmap font. Outlines by Earl Allen & Doug Miles. Public domain." fsType 0 (installable). Free to ship.
- avqest.ttf: "GemFonts 98 / Imitation Warehouse", v1.3, fsType 1 (restricted-licence embedding). No licence text in the file, and a web search found none (unverified). Helbreath-SDL ships it already ("AvQest is not a 1999 font and stays for our titles", its working/fonts/font_usage.md). The user should confirm it is OK to ship.

Plan:
- Copy both TTFs into staged/client/fonts/ (copied from the SDL repo, which stays read-only).
- Render Bitmap1/Bitmap2 text through them, at sizes matching the old glyph heights.
- For Black Chancery: digits on the cap baseline. Shift its old-style numerals at load or by a glyph offset table.
- Keep spacing, colours and shadows per call site.
- Then the old sprites 0 and 1 go: empty placeholder records, as in HH-0067.

Helbreath-SDL's font_usage.md maps each FONT1 use to a display (spellbook, text buttons, status boxes) and is a useful reference.

Waits on HH-0077 (popup headings): it touches the same popup text.

**Done when:** every Bitmap1 and Bitmap2 call draws from the TTFs, the digits sit on the baseline, both builds are clean, screenshots of the spellbook, a text button and a status popup are attached, and sprites 0 and 1 are dropped with 0 references.

Source: user in chat, 2026-11-25; font name tables read with fontTools.
